name: Kaminkehrer Schwarzgenug
personality: Can tell useful soot from the soot that has acquired a title.
visual_intent: HISTORICAL chimney sweep: tall thin bending comma blob, crushed tiny black top hat, short round soot-brush on wooden handle held upright at flank. One high brow, big cheeky open grin with TWO upper teeth; charcoal ink remains distinguishable from brush
biography: Can tell useful soot from the soot that has acquired a title. His brush removes HyperNorm soot deemed unofficial. A dissonant card asks whether the approved soot is any less dirty. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Ruß ohne Zuständigkeit wird vorrangig entfernt.

name: Waschfrau Seifenruh
personality: Has washed everything except the assumption that it will stay clean.
visual_intent: HISTORICAL laundry worker: low wide blob, cream tied headscarf and subtle lashes, small wooden washboard and ONE folded cloth. Extremely tired uneven eyelids, deep dark-purple closed toothless pout
biography: Has washed everything except the assumption that it will stay clean. Her washboard sorts HyperNorm stains into removable and the resident's own fault. A dissonant card arrives with a third kind: somebody else's tears. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Sauberkeit ist hergestellt, vorübergehend.

name: Hauswart Nassgenau
personality: Is still deciding which side of the floor counts as finished.
visual_intent: CURRENT janitor: round top-heavy blob in teal workcap and small apron patch, compact bucket with wringer and short mop held vertically, no puddle/ground. Big divergent eyes, tiny off-centre toothless triangular mouth
biography: Is still deciding which side of the floor counts as finished. His HyperNorm mop finishes one side of a boundary that keeps moving. A dissonant card proposes letting everyone cross while it dries. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Fertig ist jeweils die andere Hälfte.

name: Fensterputzer Durchblick
personality: Improves the view without changing his opinion of it.
visual_intent: CURRENT window cleaner: tall broad-based pear blob, blue soft cap, goggles parked above eyes, simple short squeegee and small spray bottle. Narrow skeptical side-eye and compressed crooked toothless lip line
biography: Improves the view without changing his opinion of it. His squeegee clears HyperNorm windows onto views the building denies possessing. A dissonant card simply enjoys looking out. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Durchblick begründet noch keine Zustimmung.

name: Dekonwartin Reinstform
personality: Removes contaminants including several that turn out to be official policy.
visual_intent: SCI-FI decontamination worker: wide asymmetrical splat, small ivory retro-space cleaning cap OPEN FACE, two lashes, ONE chunky copper vacuum wand connected by short tube to small hip canister; mouth forceful crooked open grin with ONE upper tooth. No giant suit or visor
biography: Removes contaminants including several that turn out to be official policy. Her HyperNorm vacuum collects unauthorized particles until a dissonant card asks whether imagination has a permitted grain size. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Rückstand enthält möglicherweise eine gute Idee.

name: Staubsammler Restwelt
personality: Cannot discard the dust until somebody confirms it is not an ancestor.
visual_intent: SCI-FI archival dust collector: tall drooping blob, small plum knitcap with tiny lens ABOVE eyes, ONE sealed specimen jar containing three little grey dust pellets and miniature soft brush. Unequal bulging eyes looking at jar, closed nervous toothless wavy mouth
biography: Cannot discard the dust until somebody confirms it is not an ancestor. His sealed jar holds HyperNorm dust classified as either rubbish or heritage. A dissonant card points out it can be both. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Vor Entsorgung ist die Ahnenfrage zu klären.
